notes.title: Improve water quality and optimize resources, fix bugs [2.1 Update]
notes.notes:
Hello, we're Jipang2Games.

First of all, thank you for purchasing and playing the game. Thank you for your interest during the discount period.

We checked the feedback and video and modified the graphics-related bugs. We also improved and eliminated minor parts so that there is no problem with the gameplay.

We made the dark part in the beginning of the game brighter.

We reduced game capacity by optimizing resources.

You can now adjust the resolution during the game. We recommend lowering the resolution if there is a lot of lag in the gameplay. We are trying to secure the frame even with low specifications.

For the next additional content, we have improved the quality of water. We expressed water more realistically and increased intuition.

We will continue to improve the game so that you can enjoy it more.

Thank you again.

notes.title: Official release
notes.notes:
Good morning.
This is Jipang2Games.

We have officially released it.

Thank you to all the early users who have provided a lot of feedback and help.





I think you will be able to play the game without as much bugs as possible, but it can't be without bugs at all.

Even after the official release, we will continue to monitor bugs to fix and make the game fun for users.


Thank you.

notes.title: Contents related to the official release
notes.notes:
Hi.

This is Jipang2Games.


We have uploaded the full version to Early Access and have not yet fully exposed the store,

More people have played our game than expected, and some have sent personal feedback.

Thank you very much.


In response to feedback, it is said that the difficulty is too easy in common, so we plan to address this and release it.

The difficulty level of the puzzle will only increase in the second half.


The map you've been playing with the Frog and Yellow Essence will not change much.

Lava map and I am thinking of increasing the difficulty appropriately in the ending map part.


Personally, I intend to patch while officially launching, but if there are anyone who wants to give us feedback in Early Access, I would like to proceed with the update in Early Access.


Feel free to give us your opinion, such as a comment or a tumbling buck message, and if you don't have a specific opinion, it will be officially released after several play tests and QA work.


The exact schedule for the official release has not been set yet. This is because the QA work and the step of verifying the difficulty part of the puzzle will take some time.

It won't be long for sure, and you can think of it as being released in January.



Thank you so much for everyone who played.

notes.title: Full version release
notes.notes:
Hello.

This is  Jipang2Games.

We made a whole new game.

You can now play the new game.

However, if there is a problem, it is those who have used the (old) turntack once in the past.

[b] These players must uninstall and reinstall the game to play the game without conflicting save files.[/b]

Please check this and play the game if you have previously purchased it.



Thank you to all the users who have been waiting so far.
